About:

Meet Cookie | Apply Here | Videos

Cookie has got a big noggin’ and he’s actually using it for things! This dapper and inquisitive guy is 2 years old and 25lbs. He’s just as smart as he is cute and has been wowwing the whole neighborhood since his arrival.

This sweet little man was rescued from a life lived outdoors in a cold metal cage with no flooring. A small group of advocates visited him every day, checking on him and keeping him in good spirits, until they could finally take him to a better future. It took consistent pressure, but the ‘owner’ relinquished him willingly.

Now in foster care in the city, Cookie is continuing to live large (even with his smol legs). He is doing fantastic in the crate and potty training. He loves laying on anything plush and has definitely mastered the puppy dog eyes. Outside he is adventurous and playful! He needs a little help with walking in a straight line, but mainly because he’s just so excited.

We hope you get just as excited to meet this lovely bachelor! He’ll be making his debut this weekend at @PetcoLove Block Party!!

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.
